description: Search the web with AgentSearch and return the response as pretty-printed JSON text. Use this when you have a query and need hits rather than a page body; if you already have a URL, use agentsearch_extract instead (or agentsearch_render for JavaScript-heavy pages). Free, no wallet: this remote server uses the AgentSearch free relay. Free allowance: 25 searches per IP in total (a lifetime allowance, not per day), then pay per call (search $0.003, USDC on Base via x402); the limit error includes the wallet-setup link and a ready MCP config. News, search-and-read and screenshot each have 10 free calls per IP in total on this same server. Read-only: not destructive, but it uses the network. Integers for max_results outside 1-5 are clamped (default 5), not rejected.

max_results.description: How many hits to request (1-5, default 5). Values outside that range are clamped.

query.description: Keywords or a natural-language question to search for (at least 2 characters).

name: agentsearch_web_search
title: AgentSearch Web Search
